trait.name: Arctic Camouflage
entries: The ermine's snow-white coat grants it a degree of camouflage in snowy terrain. When in snow or ice, creatures have disadvantage to see the ermine.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The ermine has advantage on Wisdom({@Perception Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Tight Squeeze
entries: The long, skinny body of an ermine allow sit to move easily through even tiny spaces, squeezing through spaces as small as 1 inch.

monster.name: Charioteer's Steed
languages: understands the languages you speak but can't speak

trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: Your Charioteer's Steed has a number of d8 Hit Dice equal to your Arcan level. It benefits from short and long rests normally.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The Steed has advantage on saving throws made against being knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Oniric Creature
entries: The Steed's oniric nature means it doesn't require food, water, or sleep, and magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Hoof
entries: {@atk mw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus (your proficiency bonus + your Major Ability modifier) to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6} + your Major Ability modifier piercing damage.

action.name: Steed Gun
entries: {@atk rw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus (your proficiency bonus + your Major Ability modifier) to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4} + your Major Ability modifier force damage.

monster.name: Arcane Skull

hp.special: Small: 5 + twice your Arcan level; Medium: 5 + three times your Arcan level

languages: understands the languages you speak but can't speak

trait.name: Oniric Creature
entries: The Skull's oniric nature means it doesn't require food, water, or sleep.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The Skull doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of a creature's reach.

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: If the Skull is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed, crumbling into ash.

trait.name: Cranial Charge (Medium Only)
entries: If the Skull moves at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a target and then hits it with a Headbutt attack on the same turn, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Arcan Aspect save DC or be pushed 10 feet in a straight line away from the Skull.

action.name: Headbutt
entries: {@atk mw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6} + your Wisdom modifier bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite (Medium Only)
entries: {@atk mw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6} + your Wisdom modifier piercing damage.

monster.name: Oniric Hecatomb
languages: understands the languages you speak but can't speak

trait.name: Oniric Creature
entries: The swarm's oniric nature means it doesn't require food, water, or sleep.

trait.name: Multitude
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for its individual components.

trait.name: Crumbling Mass
entries: While the swarm has half its hit point maximum or fewer, its attacks deal {@dice 1d6} less damage.

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: If the swarm is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed, crumbling into ash.

action.name: Legion's Assault
entries: {@atk mw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6} + your Wisdom modifier slashing damage.

monster.name: Bone Titan
languages: understands the languages you speak but can't speak

trait.name: Oniric Creature
entries: The Titan's oniric nature means it doesn't require food, water, or sleep.

trait.name: Ephemeral
entries: If the Titan is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed, crumbling into ash.

action.name: Sepulchral Slam
entries: {@atk mw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d10} + your Wisdom modifier bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Arcan Aspect save DC or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hurl Boulder
entries: {@atk rw} your Arcan Aspect attack bonus to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d10} + your Wisdom modifier bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Arcan Aspect save DC or be knocked {@condition prone}.
